def transform(grid):
    # Transform an isolated rightward horizontal bar of non-background cells
    # into color 1, preserving the rest of the grid.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for row in out:
        # Only extend a non-background shape to the edge when it is isolated
        # by background and its rightward continuation is the terminal run.
        bg = row[0]
        j = len(row) - 1
        while j >= 0 and row[j] == bg:
            j -= 1
        if j >= 0 and j < len(row) - 1:
            # The demos' trailing run starts at the first background gap after
            # the shape's last cell; recolor that right-side remainder.
            start = j + 1
            row[start:] = [1] * (len(row) - start)
    return out
